B.cust: Alex M. (a homeowner) · a family member

pf.license.need: if a contractor or home improvement license where the state or local rules require one (some only above a job size), else a business registration on file; nothing is looked up
pf.license.ask: the license or registration number and the state it's from
pf.license.holds: the business (a qualifying person on its behalf, where the state's form says so)
pf.license.checked: the state's lookup; a person on Rosie's team within 1 business day when it's down
pf.license.blocks: no install over the license's job-size limit, where the state's form sets one; a lapsed license stops new bookings for that work
pf.license.insurance: general liability, and workers' comp for a crew, where the state's form requires it; the certificate on file
pf.license.renewals: the expiry date from the lookup; reminded before it lapses

pf.services.name: Free on-site estimate
pf.services.note: measures the line, looks at slope, gates and old fence; the install is priced at it as a written estimate

pf.services.name: New fence install (wood, vinyl, chain link, aluminum)
pf.services.price: per foot, quoted at the estimate visit (written estimate), or from photos and the customer's measurements
pf.services.length: 1 to 3 days with a crew of 2 or 3
pf.services.money: a deposit when the written estimate is signed (materials are ordered with it); the rest on the bill when it's done

pf.services.name: Gate install or gate repair
pf.services.price: the example shop's own list: gate repair $175, a new walk gate from $450

pf.services.name: Fence repair (posts, panels, boards)
pf.services.price: quoted from photos first, or at the visit

pf.services.name: Old fence removal and haul-away
pf.services.price: per foot, added to an install

pf.services.name: Stain and seal a wood fence
pf.services.price: per foot, quoted from photos or at the visit

pf.services.name: Design consult (flow A)
pf.services.note: picks a style, material and height from samples; nothing is measured; the estimate visit follows at the customer's place

before_times: what's needed: a new fence, a repair, a gate, or stain
about how many feet, and the height and material wanted
is there an old fence to take out
is it around a pool (a pool fence has its own barrier rules)
does the customer own the property, or have the owner's OK
after_time: the way into the yard and any gate code (on the secure page)
dogs that will be in the yard on work days
known private lines the public locate doesn't mark: sprinklers, a pet fence, outdoor lighting, a gas line to a grill or pool heater, septic
an HOA that must approve the fence, and its approval if they have it
where the property line is: a survey or plat if they have one
pf.questions.who_may_book: an adult who owns the property, or someone the owner authorizes on a forwarded link (a renter or a property manager); never a minor

stop_words: someone hurt by a tool or a falling post
pf.safety.tell_customer: Gas smell or a hit gas line: leave the area now, and call 911 and the gas company from away. A downed power line: stay far away and call 911 and the power company. No booking until it's safe.
pf.safety.continue: a fence knocked down by a storm or a car is booked once the area is safe (no lines down)
pf.safety.on_the_job: no digging until the public utility locate marks are in; the crew stops at once if a line is hit or a mark is near the hole; pets and children kept inside while the crew works; the yard can be open while the old fence is out

pf.first_steps.step: the estimate visit (measure and written estimate)
pf.first_steps.timing: booked first, as its own visit

pf.first_steps.step: the written estimate signed and the deposit paid
pf.first_steps.timing: materials take 1 to 3 weeks; the install day is set after they arrive

pf.first_steps.step: the public utility locate (call before you dig)
pf.first_steps.timing: a few business days before digging; no digging until the lines are marked

pf.first_steps.step: a fence permit, where the local rules require one
pf.first_steps.who: the business pulls it unless the owner wants to
pf.first_steps.timing: the times start after its lead time; no work before it's approved

pf.first_steps.step: HOA approval, where there is an HOA

pf.first_steps.who: the customer (a survey or plat where unsure)
pf.first_steps.timing: before the install day; the crew never sets a fence on a line the customer can't confirm

pf.visit.check_in: estimate visits: the customer's code at the door; install days: the code if someone's home, else nobody needs to be home when the yard is open (DONE with photos)
pf.visit.work_changes: rock or roots found while digging (priced per hole, the customer's yes first); more old fence to remove; a gate added; any change is priced and the customer says yes first
pf.visit.proof: DONE with photos of the finished fence and gates; a walk-through with the customer when they're home
pf.visit.multiday: posts set in concrete on day 1, panels or chain link on day 2 once it cures

pf.money.defaults: estimate visit free; installs: a deposit when the written estimate is signed, the rest on the bill when it's done; repairs and gates: nothing before, the bill after
pf.money.deposit_cap: where the state caps a home improvement deposit, the cap from the state's form, shown as a suggested rule
pf.money.bank_transfer: big install bills may be paid by bank transfer
pf.money.materials: custom materials ordered for the job: a cancel after the order keeps only what the signed estimate's schedule says, from money already taken
pf.money.rosfield_fee: $2 per confirmed booking (not a health practice or a law firm)

pf.messages.never_in_text: gate or lockbox codes, money details
pf.messages.minors: not served; a minor can't book

pf.staff.roles: an estimator (measures and writes the estimate) and install crews (a crew lead and 1 or 2 helpers)
pf.staff.license: the crew lead or the business holds any license the state's form asks; helpers work under the crew lead
pf.staff.stand_in: any crew lead with the skill may take an install; the estimator who wrote the estimate needn't be there
pf.staff.who_oks: the owner OKs quotes over their limit

pf.rules.written_contract: a written estimate signed before an install, where the state's form requires one above an amount
pf.rules.cancel_period: work sold at the customer's place: the written cancel period where the state's form gives one (switch cancelright)
pf.rules.license_number: on estimates and bills, where the state's form requires it
pf.rules.permits: a fence permit where the local rules require one; height and pool barrier rules from the local rules
pf.rules.records: estimates, contracts and photos kept 7 years
pf.rules.warranty: the business's own workmanship warranty (for example 1 year)

pf.edges.weather: rain, frozen ground or a storm: concrete can't set; the business moves the day (the business can't give it)
pf.edges.rock: rock or roots in a post hole: extra per hole, priced first, the customer's yes
pf.edges.line_hit: a utility line hit: stop, safety first, the owner told
pf.edges.property_line: a neighbor disputes the line: the work stops on that side until the customer settles it
pf.edges.materials_late: materials not in by the install day: the business moves the day
pf.edges.nobody_home: fine when the yard is open and the way in is on the secure page
pf.edges.dog: a dog loose in the yard: the crew doesn't go in; the customer is asked to bring it in
pf.edges.hoa: HOA approval not in by the install day: the customer's side; the day moves
